NFT-backed liquidation. LendPool.liquidate delegates to LiquidateLogic.executeLiquidate, whose load-bearing guard is: require(block.timestamp > vars.auctionEndTimestamp, Errors.LPL_BID_AUCTION_DURATION_NOT_END). The error constant resolves to the literal numeric string "490" (string public constant LPL_BID_AUCTION_DURATION_NOT_END = "490"; in libraries/helpers/Errors.sol). Reverts until the bid-auction window has expired. Parameters: nftAsset + nftTokenId + amount. Covers BendDAO Core only (proxy 0x70b97A0da65C15dfb0FFA02aEE6FA36e507C2762, impl 0x9015b2c79064a07c7a40f390485177931c2817c3). The RQ1-identified "BendDAO MAYC Pool" at 0x69f37e419bd1457d2a25ed3f5d418169caae8d1f is the boundMAYC BNFT wrapper, not a LendPool — its ABI exposes ERC-721 wrapping, NFT flash loans, and airdrop-claim utilities, with no liquidate function. Recorded as architectural absence per A11 (BendDAO MAYC FlashLoan events are NFT flash loans, not token flash loans). Added under D54; MAYC inheritance claim corrected under Session 34e. Audited via Etherscan ABI Ctrl+F 'liquidat' on LendPool implementation. Verbatim source evidence: thesis Appendix D.6 (app:l2-step2-proofs).
